name: 左文右插圖分欄＋跨界底部卡片
desc: 純色背景的左右兩欄主視覺：左欄是靠左的標題與按鈕，右欄是大插圖；底部有一張橫向卡片跨在主視覺底邊上。
prompt: 背景為純色滿版，版面分左右兩欄：左欄是文字欄，約佔畫面寬四成多，右欄放一張大插圖（約方形），約佔畫面寬一半，明顯大於文字欄；兩欄都在主視覺內垂直置中，文字組上下的留白大致相同。左欄由上而下放大標題（可多行）、說明文字和一顆主要按鈕，全部靠左對齊、對齊頁面內容寬度的左緣，按鈕在文字組最下方。大標題上方可放一個小標籤；說明文字下方可放更小的次要文字，次要文字和按鈕之間可放一段強調短句，強調短句上方留較大的空白；這些可省略的元素沒有內容時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，兩欄比例不變、等比縮放。
mobile: 左右兩欄改為上下排列，順序為：小標籤、大標題、說明文字與次要文字在最上方並靠左對齊；插圖放在文字下方，置中且接近整個畫面寬；強調短句放在插圖下方；主要按鈕放在插圖和強調短句下方，置中。高度仍是底邊約在畫面九成高的位置，下方露出下一個區塊的開頭。插圖內的動畫保留。

en.name: Split text left, illustration right, with straddling bottom card
en.desc: A two-column hero on a solid background: left-aligned headline and button in the left column, a large illustration in the right column, and a horizontal card straddling the bottom edge of the hero.
en.prompt: The background is a full-bleed solid color, and the layout is split into two columns: the left column holds the text and takes a little over forty percent of the viewport width; the right column holds a large illustration (roughly square) that takes about half the viewport width and is clearly larger than the text column; both columns are vertically centered within the hero, with roughly equal space above and below the text group. In the left column, place, from top to bottom, a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), a description and a primary button, all left-aligned and aligned with the left edge of the page content width, with the button at the bottom of the text group. Optionally place a label above the headline; optionally place smaller secondary text below the description, and a short emphasized phrase between the secondary text and the button, with a larger gap above the emphasized phrase; omit these optional elements when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.tablet: Tablet keeps the desktop layout; the column proportions stay the same and everything scales proportionally.
en.mobile: The two columns stack vertically in this order: the label, headline, description and secondary text at the top, left-aligned; the illustration below the text, centered and nearly the full viewport width; the emphasized phrase below the illustration; and the primary button below the illustration and the emphasized phrase, centered. The bottom edge stays at about ninety percent of the viewport height, revealing the start of the next section. The animation inside the illustration is kept.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺底部整列放一張橫向卡片，寬度約等於頁面內容寬度並置中；卡片跨在主視覺底邊上，約一半在主視覺內、另一半超出主視覺疊到下一個區塊上方。卡片內左側放一排小標誌圖片，右側放一個文字連結，兩者之間有一條直向分隔線。
accessories.mobile: 底部的橫向卡片在手機版保留左右留邊，內部改為上下排列：上方一排小標誌圖片，中間一條橫向分隔線，下方是文字連結；卡片仍跨在主視覺底邊上，上半部在主視覺內、下半部疊到下一個區塊上方。

en.prompt: In a full-width row along the bottom of the hero, place a horizontal card about as wide as the page content width and centered; the card straddles the bottom edge of the hero, with about half inside the hero and the other half extending beyond it, overlapping the top of the next section. Inside the card, place a row of small logo images on the left and a text link on the right, separated by a vertical divider.
en.mobile: On mobile, the horizontal bottom card keeps side margins and its contents stack vertically: a row of small logo images on top, a horizontal divider in the middle and the text link below; the card still straddles the bottom edge of the hero, with the upper half inside the hero and the lower half overlapping the top of the next section.

extras.name: 插圖內的循環小動畫
extras.prompt: 右欄插圖裡的小元素持續循環動態：小圖形依序出現、消失或變化，不跟著捲動，也不需要互動。
extras.mobile: 手機版保留，插圖移到文字下方後動畫不變。

en.name: Looping micro-animation inside the illustration
en.prompt: Small elements inside the right-column illustration animate in a continuous loop: small shapes appear, disappear or change in sequence, independent of scrolling and without any interaction.
en.mobile: Kept on mobile; the animation is unchanged after the illustration moves below the text.
